description: Elections Commission - Declare that Yakdehige Ajith Nishantha as a member of the Tangalle Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Tangalle Pradeshiya Sabha) due to a resignation, as per the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the electoral process, specifically the nomination and declaration of a new elected member, which falls under the Elections category (Type 7).
